title: Curcumin supplementation improves vascular endothelial function in ...
abstract: The study investigated the effects of curcumin supplementation on vascular endothelial function and arterial stiffness in healthy middle-aged and older adults. The findings indicate that 12 weeks of curcumin supplementation (2000 mg/day of Longvida®) improved both resistance and conduit artery endothelial function. This improvement in resistance artery endothelial function was attributed to increased nitric oxide bioavailability and reduced vascular oxidative stress. However, curcumin supplementation did not significantly affect large elastic artery stiffness or circulating markers of oxidative stress and inflammation in this population. The study also noted that while both men and women experienced improvements in conduit artery endothelial function, the magnitude of improvement was greater in men. The curcumin formulation used was found to be safe and well-tolerated.
